title: Structured launch briefs and customer-segmented changelog templates
creator: Riley Chen
description: Goal: Create a single-source, structured launch brief and a set of changelog templates that are tailored to primary customer segments (developer/PLG, platform teams, enterprise/security/compliance). Deliverables: 1) One-page Launch Brief template for internal stakeholders (PM/Eng/Design/Sales/Support/Legal/Trust). 2) Three customer-facing changelog templates (Developer bulletin, Platform operations note, Enterprise compliance summary) with consistent fields: summary, behavioral change, action required, risk & mitigation, rollout schedule, docs/links, translation keys, redaction guidance. 3) Sign-off checklist and timeline for cross-team reviews (design, legal, security, translations, support playbook). 4) Automated mapping guidance for release tools that populate the templates (Console changelog UI, internal release tracker). Why: current release notes vary in tone and structure, causing inconsistent customer experience and missed compliance signoffs for Dedicated/Private customers. Having structured briefs reduces review friction and ensures critical items (breaking changes, migration steps, KMS/HSM notes) are surfaced for enterprise customers.
acceptance_criteria: Deliver a one-page internal launch brief template and populated example for runtime-1.18 rollout
Provide three distinct customer-facing changelog templates and a ready example produced from runtime-1.18 changes
Sign-off flow documented with responsible owners and SLAs (24h design, 48h legal, 48h translations for core locales)
Translation keys and redaction flags included in template; example exported to translation spreadsheet
Console changelog UI mapping matrix documented (field -> Console property) and a short README for the release automation team
